title: Epic: Agent Backend
description: Build the LangGraph agent backend with CodeLlama 7B, implement file read/write tools, shell execution tool, and SSE streaming bridge

title: Implement file-read tool with path validation
description: Create app/lib/agent/tools/file-read.ts. Implement a LangGraph tool that reads file contents with Zod schema validation. Include path validation to ensure files are within the project directory. Export as fileReadTool(projectPath).

title: Implement file-write tool with path validation
description: Create app/lib/agent/tools/file-write.ts. Implement a LangGraph tool that writes/creates files with Zod schema validation. Include path validation to ensure files are within the project directory. Support creating parent directories. Export as fileWriteTool(projectPath).

title: Implement shell command execution tool
description: Create app/lib/agent/tools/shell.ts. Implement a LangGraph tool that executes shell commands with Zod schema validation. Set cwd to project path. Capture stdout/stderr. No command restrictions for MVP. Export as shellTool(projectPath).

title: Create LangGraph agent with CodeLlama 7B and tools
description: Create app/lib/agent/graph.ts. Use createReactAgent from @langchain/langgraph/prebuilt with Ollama (CodeLlama 7B model). Import and configure the three tools. Write system prompt describing the AI developer assistant. Export createAgent(projectPath) function.

title: Build SSE streaming bridge from LangGraph to TanStack AI format
description: Create app/lib/agent/stream-bridge.ts. Convert LangGraph's streaming format (agent.stream with streamMode: 'messages') to TanStack AI's SSE message format. Handle AI message chunks and tool calls. Export langGraphToSSE async generator.

title: Epic: Chat Frontend
description: Build the TanStack Start web interface with chat UI, message display, project path configuration, and modern styling

title: Create /api/chat route with streaming SSE response
description: Create app/routes/api/chat.tsx. Implement POST handler that receives messages and project path from client. Create LangGraph agent for the project. Stream agent response using the SSE bridge and toServerSentEventsResponse from TanStack AI. Handle errors properly.

title: Build Chat UI component with useChat hook
description: Create app/components/Chat.tsx. Use useChat from @tanstack/ai-react with fetchServerSentEvents connection to /api/chat. Include input field, send button, and loading states. Pass project path to API.

title: Implement message display with tool execution feedback
description: Create app/components/Message.tsx. Display messages with role-based styling (user vs assistant). Show tool execution feedback (which tool was called, results). Handle streaming message parts. Support thinking/reasoning display if available.

title: Add project path configuration input
description: Add project path configuration to Chat UI. Include input field with validation, default to current directory, persist in localStorage. Allow users to change project path before sending messages.

title: Style the chat interface with modern design
description: Apply modern styling to the chat interface. Use Tailwind CSS or similar. Create clean, professional design with good UX. Responsive layout, proper spacing, readable typography. Include loading states, hover effects, and smooth transitions.

title: Epic: Project Setup
description: Initialize TanStack Start project with Bun runtime, configure TypeScript, add dependencies (LangGraph, TanStack AI, Ollama for local LLM)

title: Initialize TanStack Start project with Bun runtime
description: Set up a new TanStack Start project using the start-basic template with Bun as the runtime. Run: bunx create-tanstack-app@latest . --template start-basic

title: Configure TypeScript and add dependencies
description: Install and configure dependencies: @tanstack/react-router, @tanstack/react-start, @tanstack/ai, @tanstack/ai-react, @langchain/langgraphjs, @langchain/community (for Ollama), @langchain/core, zod. Ensure TypeScript is properly configured.

title: Set up environment configuration
description: Create .env file with OPENAI_API_KEY placeholder. Add .env to .gitignore. Document environment variables needed in README or configuration file.
delete_reason: Using local CodeLlama model instead of OpenAI, no API keys needed
